original_test_intent: Verify each SMBIOS Type 4 Processor Serial Number string, including an explicitly supported absent value, matches the approved per-socket identity policy and remains associated with the same processor record after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw/decoded Type 4 records under controlled evidence handling, retain the serial string index and resolved value per socket/handle, compare with the approved inventory or absence policy, reboot and repeat with identical normalization.
manual_activity: A user approves the expected serial/absence policy, identifier handling and reboot plan. Controlled collection, normalization, mapping and comparison are automatable.
required_inputs: Expected processor serial per socket or explicit unsupported/absent-value policy
Approved mapping between socket, Type 4 handle and inventory identity
Normalization rules for empty, whitespace, placeholder and duplicate values
Masking, access, retention and report-display policy for processor identifiers
Validated tool plus approved reboot and OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only; do not alter CPU hardware, serial programming or firmware.
Treat processor serials as controlled identifiers: restrict raw artifacts and mask summaries according to the approved evidence policy.
Preserve raw string index/value securely; grep output can mix the same label from different SMBIOS structure types or processors.
Do not require uniqueness or a non-empty value unless the platform specification does; supported absence must be distinguished from parser loss.
Stop on unauthorized identifier exposure, mapping ambiguity, unapproved drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect controlled complete Type 4 data, map socket/handle, resolve and normalize the Serial Number string, compare approved identity/absence before and after reboot.
Do not expose raw identifiers beyond the approved evidence path, change CPU state or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve expected values or absence/placeholder semantics and identifier-handling controls.
Confirm inventory mapping, approve reboot/recovery and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The target label is relevant, but grep may collect serial fields from adjacent records, suppresses errors and lacks raw string-index, socket mapping and privacy controls.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 4 records in controlled storage, retain handle/socket/string index, apply approved normalization and emit masked comparison results.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Processor Serial Number scope, Type 4 script and 10/10-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Resolve the Type 4 serial string index for every expected socket, distinguish supported absence from malformed/missing data, compare under approved normalization and store raw identifiers only in access-controlled evidence.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 4 systems where the serial field is present in the formatted structure version.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS, processor inventory, parser/dmidecode and evidence-policy revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 4 Serial Number string semantics, approved platform inventory policy and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds string-index provenance, absence semantics, per-socket mapping and privacy controls.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; prevents both false failures on unsupported values and loss of identity defects.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A firmware-provided string is not independently trustworthy as a physical CPU identifier without an approved inventory source.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve exact serials, masked comparisons or a documented absent/placeholder value. It must not publish raw identifiers or assert uniqueness when the platform does not guarantee it.
expected_evidence: Approved serial/absence/masking policy, socket mapping and platform/tool versions
Access-controlled pre-reboot complete Type 4 capture with raw string index/value and masked per-socket comparison
Equivalent controlled post-reboot capture proving association and persistence
Sanitized report plus engineer verdict; raw identifiers retained only as authorized

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item and persistence criterion consistently target the Serial Number string; absent-value semantics are missing inputs rather than contradictory source instructions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The field is safely readable with controlled evidence handling; missing baseline or access policy is execution readiness, not permanent blocking.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds complete per-socket mapping, absence semantics, raw index provenance and identifier controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its privacy-aware comparison while correcting capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE and separating engineer verdict.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Prevents unsupported/blank values from being treated automatically as defects and prevents unapproved serial disclosure.

review_improvement: Balances identity correctness with privacy and distinguishes absent firmware support from a missing record or parser failure.
independent_technical_reasoning: Once values/absence and evidence controls are approved, all collection, normalization, protected comparison and reboot persistence checks are software-controlled.
